versions.changelog:
Initial release of ai-compute-x402: 27-tool AI compute agent with managed and decentralized AI services.

- Offers text, image, video generation; text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and embeddings.
- Includes endpoints for GPU inference, Bittensor decentralized AI, and on-chain AI analytics.
- Add compute futures for prepaid credits with discounted pricing tiers.
- All actions are invoked via simple bash scripts with real micropayments per call.
- Supports advanced workflows: content generation, RAG/knowledge apps, audio transcription, and blockchain intelligence.
